instructions.text: Use a concise query containing the task’s distinctive terms or domain. Add descriptive words when results are too broad; spelling and capitalization usually do not need exact matching.
When the task requires a particular website’s content, the site:domain operator can narrow the query. Read the result’s displayed domain before opening it.
Fill the observed Search control with the query, then choose the offered search submission action. A visible suggestion list is not the same as a loaded results page.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Suggested workflow for searchbox and combobox observations; grounded in current control state.

instructions.text: Use the result’s title, domain, and snippet together. For an official-site task, verify the resulting page URL and identity after opening it instead of assuming the first result is correct.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Proposed source-identity check; ranking does not establish official ownership.

instructions.text: If results or previews are still loading, wait for the relevant content before making another selection. When a result opens another tab, inspect the observed tabs and continue in the new destination.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Flick exposes wait and switch_tab choices; suggested recovery for asynchronous navigation.

instructions.text: Once the requested destination is verified, continue the website task there. Repeating the same search or returning to Google without new evidence does not advance that task.

provenance.evidence: Project workflow guidance, not validated live in this app. Proposed milestone check to avoid navigation loops.
